title: Sales Development Representative, Deel IT | LATAM
description:
Summary

Deel IT exists to equip the world's talent with the means to do their best work. Through one slick platform customers can procure, deploy, repair & recover entire fleets of devices and home office equipment for their employees in over 130 countries.

As our Sales Development Representative (SDR) for Deel IT , you’ll play a vital role in our team by opening doors to new and existing opportunities by building strong relationships across all levels of our target customer segments. You’ll contribute directly to our growth, creating a significant impact in the company’s journey. This position will give you the chance to collaborate with our sales team, conduct market research to identify potential customers, work to expand current business, and qualify leads through insightful conversations about device and equipment management.

Please note: This role requires that you reside within Latin America (LATAM) and are fluent in both English and Spanish.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive Growth: Fuel our company’s growth by generating high-quality outbound leads (both new business and existing business) that can convert into meaningful sales opportunities and business wins.
  • Collaborate & Learn: Work alongside a seasoned sales team to build out our world-class Sales Playbook and Tech Stack, while sharing your insights to make these resources even better.
  • Engage & Educate: Engage leads through various channels—phone, email, events, webinars, and campaigns—to educate them and build interest in our solutions.
  • Master the Process: Develop a deep understanding of each stage in the lead generation process, from marketing initiatives and touchpoints to the transition of leads to an Account Executive.
  • Build & Refine Outreach: Create targeted email sequences and confidently reach out via cold calls to identify key contacts, establish relationships, and deepen connections.
  • Follow Through: Conduct timely follow-ups to nurture relationships and set up valuable meetings with our Account Executives.

What We’re Looking For

  • Fluency: in both English and Spanish.
  • Growth-Oriented: You have a proactive approach and thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong growth mindset.
  • Strong Communicator: You’re skilled at crafting messages that resonate and have experience writing emails and campaign copy that converts.
  • Team Player: You’re a natural relationship-builder who collaborates well with both internal and external teams, bringing fresh ideas to improve processes and communication.
  • Adaptable & Curious: You enjoy learning, embrace change, and are eager to evolve in a dynamic work environment.

Bonus Points (Not Required)

  • Experience in HR, Fintech, IT or related fields
  • Background in a fast-growing startup
  • Previous experience in a remote or distributed team

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you! These qualities are essential for success in this role, so please apply if you’re excited to bring these skills to our team and grow with us. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are looking for passionate individuals ready to make an impact.

Want to stand out? We encourage you to prospect us! Reach out to the hiring team to let us know you’ve applied—show us your skills in action and demonstrate your proactive approach to building connections.

Total Rewards

Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.

Some things you’ll enjoy

  • Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
  • Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
  • The flexibility of remote work, including optional WeWork access

At Deel, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Deel will provide accommodation on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team at of the nature of the accommodation that you may require, to ensure your equal participation.

title: Analista de Controle Acadêmico
description:
Overview

A Associação Santa Marcelina dedica-se à construção de uma Rede de Educação formada por faculdades, escolas e obras sociais. Presente em 9 Estados, atendendo mais de 17 mil alunos, da Educação Infantil à Educação Superior, a instituição é reconhecida por seu empenho em transformar a sociedade, tendo a ciência como instrumento e os valores cristãos como essência.

Main responsibilities

  • Acompanhar toda a operação acadêmica em auxílio a Diretoria Acadêmica, incluindo o calendário de aulas presenciais e online da graduação, atividades da pós-graduação e cursos de curta duração, apoiando em ações específicas que demandem maior concentração, como produção de relatórios e indicadores que corroborem com decisões estratégicas da Diretoria Acadêmica.
  • Atualizar e criar documentos institucionais, como manuais, e-books de cursos e demais materiais acadêmicos, garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes pedagógicas e operacionais.
  • Realizar processos operacionais na área acadêmica, como lançamentos em sistemas institucionais (GVDASA), elaboração de planilhas, organização de documentações e suporte a demandas administrativas.
  • Monitorar o planejamento e execução das ofertas de cursos, assegurando que cronogramas, matrizes curriculares e ementas sejam cumpridos conforme os padrões institucionais e normativos.
  • Gerar relatórios gerenciais e análises sobre o andamento dos programas acadêmicos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo ações estratégicas para aprimoramento contínuo.
  • Prestar assessoria técnico-pedagógica às unidades, apoiando docentes e coordenadores na implementação de metodologias, inovação educacional e práticas que elevem a qualidade do ensino.
  • Apoiar a equipe de EAD, produzindo e gerindo indicadores, com o objetivo de manter inovações didático-pedagógicas para aprimorar a qualidade educacional.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Superior Completo: Pedagogia, Administração, Gestão Educacional e Especialização em Andamento na área da Educação.
  • Conhecimentos em regulamentações do ensino superior (MEC, LDB, Diretrizes Curriculares), gestão acadêmica, indicadores de desempenho, processos administrativos educacionais. Domínio em organização documental, planejamento educacional, metodologias de ensino, EAD e inovação pedagógica. Análise de dados, gestão de projetos e avaliação institucional.

Additional information

  • Local de Trabalho: Faculdade Santa Marcelina - Unidade Perdizes.
  • Horário: Segunda á Quinta das 09:00 ás 19:00 e Sextas das 09:00 ás 18:00.
  • Benefícios: Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Wellhub (Gympass), Pronto Atendimento via Telemedicina e Seguro de Vida.

Overview

Solveplan é a principal consultoria SAP da América Latina especializada em Planejamento Orçamentário, Consolidação Societária e Analytics , com foco nas soluções SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Business Data Cloud e Group Reporting . Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em gestão comercial B2B, preferencialmente em consultoria de tecnologia ou serviços complexos.
  • Forte domínio em processos de vendas consultivas, com atuação em ciclos de venda longos e contas estratégicas.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos, organizar rotinas e transformar dados comerciais em informações para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência em processos de alinhamento entre área comercial e operações (S&OP), garantindo previsibilidade de entregas.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno ou Sênior
description:
Overview

A hub xp é uma software house referência em outsourcing de tecnologia e está conduzindo um processo seletivo para atuar em um de nossos principais clientes — uma multinacional líder nos setores de Educação e Saúde , com forte presença internacional e listada na Bolsa de Nova York (NYSE) .

Trata-se de um ambiente de alta performance, inovação contínua e impacto real na vida de milhões de pessoas , onde você terá a chance de contribuir em projetos estratégicos, com tecnologias de ponta e amplo espaço para crescimento profissional .

Sobre a Vaga

Procuramos um(a) Analytics Engineer para liderar a evolução da nossa camada de transformação de dados. Este profissional será peça fundamental na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados confiáveis usando DBT, atuando como ponte entre a engenharia de dados e o time de análise, garantindo que os dados estejam prontos e otimizados para consumo analítico.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter a camada de transformação de dados usando DBT como ferramenta principal
  • Projetar e implementar modelos de dados no data warehouse seguindo melhores práticas
  • Criar pipelines de transformação escaláveis e reutilizáveis em DBT
  • Implementar e garantir aderência ao GitFlow nos processos de desenvolvimento DBT
  • Documentar extensivamente modelos, transformações e lógicas de negócio
  • Dar suporte técnico ao time de análise de dados, facilitando a transição para práticas modernas de data engineering
  • Estabelecer padrões de qualidade de dados e testes automatizados no DBT
  • Otimizar performance de queries e transformações no warehouse
  • Capacitar analistas de dados em práticas de versionamento e DBT
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica detalhada de todos os processos

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação em Engenharia, Ciências da Computação ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência sólida com DBT (Data Build Tool)
  • Modelagem incremental e materialização
  • Macros e testes customizados
  • Documentação e lineage de dados
  • Orquestração de jobs
  • Domínio de Git e GitFlow
  • Branching strategies
  • Pull requests e code review
  • Resolução de conflitos
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Experiência com SQL avançado e otimização de queries
  • Conhecimento em Python para automação e scripts de dados
  • Experiência com Data Warehouses modernos (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift ou Databricks)
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com conceitos de modelagem dimensional
  • Habilidade para criar documentação técnica clara e completa

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em migração de processos ETL legados para DBT
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Prefect)
  • Familiaridade com DataOps e práticas de CI/CD para dados
  • Experiência em treinar e capacitar equipes técnicas
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de catálogo de dados
  • Certificações em plataformas cloud ou DBT

Competências Comportamentais

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação técnica
  • Paciência e didática para ensinar conceitos complexos
  • Mentalidade de engenharia e foco em escalabilidade
  • Colaboração efetiva com diferentes níveis de maturidade técnica
  • Proatividade na identificação e solução de problemas
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes

Diferencial desta Posição

Esta é uma oportunidade única para ser o(a) responsável pela modernização e evolução da arquitetura de dados analíticos da empresa, liderando a adoção de práticas modernas de analytics engineering e sendo referência técnica para o time.

Modelo de contratação

  • 100% remoto
  • Contrato PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)
  • Projeto inicial de 03 meses, com possibilidade de renovação e/ou internalização no cliente.

Processo Seletivo

  • Análise de perfil LinkedIn
  • Teste técnico
  • Entrevista técnica com time da hub xp
  • Entrevista com o cliente
  • Feedback e contratação

Overview

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 7,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You\'ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview

The Loan Officer Assistant position supports the Melville, NY office of CrossCountry Mortgage. The Loan Officer Assistant is responsible for accurately setting up new purchase applications, issuing pre-approval letters, processing and disclosing loans, and overseeing the success of every loan from contract to close. The Loan Officer Assistant will work with Borrowers, Loan Officers, Underwriters, and any Third Parties to close 95% of all loans on time while providing an outstanding experience from application to closing.

This position operates within Eastern Standard Time Zone working hours to support the East Coast region.

Job Responsibilities

  • Serve as Primary contact and liaison between clients, Branch Manager, Branch Sales Manager and/or assigned Loan Originator(s).
  • Contact all borrower(s) within 24 hours after the LO appointment, fully review the loan applications and other documents with borrowers and effectively communicate all pre-approval parameters to borrowers.
  • Request and review the cash, credit, and income qualifications of all borrowers.
  • Review documentation received within 24 hours of receipt for discrepancies, omissions, verified income calculation, asset verification and Encompass updates based on verified information; immediately notify Loan Originators when any discrepancies are found on documentation. Track all requested documents in Encompass.
  • Communicate any red flags or major potential issues to the LO or Team Captain (if applicable) and Realtor partner and ensure understanding of all required conditions before contacting borrowers or third parties.
  • Meet deadlines (loan documents to title 3 days before closing) while maintaining multiple assignments/projects.
  • Handle all payment scenario requests.
  • Accurately pre-approve all borrowers and supplement the pre-approval letter with any pertinent documents (i.e., Pre-Approval Addendum, completed All About You form, etc.). Rush pre-approval requests when necessary.
  • Provide a courtesy phone call to the referring Realtor within 24 hours of issuance, ensuring they fully understand any important details of the pre-approval. Communicate effectively to all respective Realtor partners with updates as needed.
  • Accurately onboard all newly received contracts for Rate Lock consultation.
  • Expeditiously submit and disclose the loan application to remain TRID compliant.
  • Provide outstanding Borrower Tuesday Updates, Pre-Closing, and Funding Calls (if applicable).
  • Ensure 95% of all loans close on time with a mandatory daily gauge check to address choke points.
  • Attend weekly pipeline calls to handle 95% of all loan problems before escalating to the LO and ensure all required time-to-task objectives are met.
  • Provide excellent customer service both internally and externally.
  • Available to work varying hours and overtime if needed.

Qualifications and Skills

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 3 years\' current conventional fixed and ARM, HELOC and construction mortgage loan processing or origination experience.
  • State and Federal NMLS License preferred.
  • Experience in Mortgage Loan Processing.
  • Experience with RESPA and mortgage and consumer lending regulations and loan documents, preferred.
  • Working knowledge of all major investors\' guidelines.
  • Experience with Encompass.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Skill in utilizing text messaging platforms effectively.
  • Excellent prioritization skills to meet established deadlines and KPIs.
  • Skill in analyzing cash, credit and income to ensure accurate pre-approval.
  • Proficient in DU, LP, Microsoft Office & Windows and ability to adapt to new technologies.

Pay Range

  • Hourly Rate: $28.00 - $30.00
  • This position is bonus plan eligible.

The posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Com mais de 80 anos de história, o hospital é um dos mais tradicionais da cidade. Atualmente, o Hospital Vera Cruz conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e pronto atendimento 24h. Além disso, oferece atendimento em mais de 66 especialidades médicas e possui Acreditação ONA 3, estando em processo de preparação para a certificação JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Hospital Vera Cruz, expandimos significativamente nossa rede em Campinas e região. Isso inclui a inauguração de novos serviços, como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia e a Unidade de Atenção Primária à Saúde, além da criação de unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba. Também adquirimos a Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais emblemáticos da cidade, instalado em um prédio centenário que faz parte do patrimônio particular local. Technical Expertise & Account Support

  • Evaluate and assist in the development, testing, and deployment of new technologies to aid various engineering stakeholders

Risk Management & Compliance

  • Ensure effective collaboration with HSSE teams to deliver compliance and assurance programs that meet JLL standards

Talent Development

  • Interview and assess technical resources, identify and monitor development of engineering talent
  • Deploy technical training programs and certification initiatives aligned with Education and Professional Development strategy
  • Assist in the onboarding process for new accounts and technical resources
  • Contribute to the development of high-performing team of engineering professionals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate extensively with other functions within the Center of Expertise to maximize the value of platform programs
  • Connect accounts with appropriate SMEs across the organization when specialized expertise is required
  • Support engineering operations transition activities for new business and expansions
  • Drive consistent implementation of engineering programs across client portfolios

  • Strong knowledge of building codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements a plus
  • Experience developing standard operating procedures and implementing assurance programs
  • Proven leadership experience with demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance. This opportunity will allow you to dive deep into Copilot technologies, shape how AI quality is measured at scale, build critical skills in the AI-era, and rapidly grow your career.

Our mission is to drive operational excellence and innovation across the M365 fleet by leveraging AI, automation, and deep platform integration.

Your core mission will be to deliver exciting innovation in Microsoft Copilot. Microsoft Copilot is revolutionizing how people work and have created an unprecedented opportunity to advance the state-of-the-art in a way that benefits millions of people.

More About Your Responsibilities

We are seeking candidates with research skills and the desire to pursue the cutting edge in model development that pushes technological boundaries. We are looking for candidates with interest and experience in language model training, large language model evaluation, and quality assessment. In particular we would like a candidate that has a passion for understanding what makes an AI solution work and how to measure its performance.

title: Project Director
description:
Overview

Are you a socially conscious, dedicated individual who is committed to building a better future for children, families, and their communities? If so, join us as we support early childhood education programs across the country to create positive outcomes for the children and families served.

Are you a strategic leader with a passion for growth, innovation, and transforming the landscape of early childhood education? We are looking for a dynamic Project Director to drive our mission to eliminate the gaps between young children’s potential and their success in school and life.

Why Acelero?

Our mission is bold: To design and deliver research and evidence-based approaches to eliminate the gaps between young childrenʼs inherent potential and their achievement in school and life. With our partners, we accelerate child and family outcomes that honor all of the aspirations and cultures of the communities we serve.

Our values: Data-Informed Learning; Transparent & Open Communication; Growth Mindset; Championing Equality; Caring Teams & Communities.

Your Role

As the Project Director for North Carolina Family Child Care Network (FCCN) you will be responsible for increasing family and community engagement; increasing provider quality rating assessment scores; and providing a learning environment for family child care home providers to enhance their professional growth - and deliver high quality early care and education. The foundation provides leadership and operational oversight for partners, Shine’s direct service, and subcontractors on this project. This role requires a highly organized, systems-oriented leader with demonstrated experience in budget management, project execution, and strategic collaboration. The Project Director oversees the day-to-day implementation, ensures alignment with project goals, timelines, and deliverables. The Project Director is responsible for coordinating across partners and subcontractors, managing direct and indirect staff, and ensuring the use of data to deliver high-quality communities of practice, coaching, and technical assistance. The Project Director will also serve as the primary liaison to state and local partners, ensuring the foundation’s work is aligned with North Carolina’s early childhood system priorities.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the planning, execution, and oversight of all project initiatives, ensuring alignment with deliverables, timelines, and performance metrics.

  • Serve as the primary liaison between The Acelero Foundation, Shine, North Carolina’s Division of Child Development and Early Education, community partners, and subcontracted partners.

  • Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with statewide, regional, and local stakeholders.

  • Develop detailed project schedules, task assignments, and milestone trackers in collaboration with Shine and subcontractor teams.

  • Facilitate project and partner meetings to monitor progress, address barriers, and ensure accountability across all partners, while providing regular updates to funders and internal leadership.

  • Manage all aspects of the SPARK North Carolina Family Child Care (FCC) Network budget, including budget planning, monitoring, and reporting in collaboration with Shine’s finance team.

  • Maintain a complex budget and ensure accurate disaggregation, reporting, and compliance.

  • Review and approve subcontractor invoices and expense reports, ensuring alignment with contract terms and deliverables.

  • Monitor expenses and adjust financial plans as needed to meet project and contract obligations.

  • Ensure fiscal accountability, timely disbursements, and compliance with state and federal requirements.

  • Provide financial reporting and updates aligned with both DCDEE and Shine fiscal policies.

  • Contribute to the growth of the Acelero Foundation.

  • Use data to drive decisions and produce reports that highlight effective practices and areas for improvement.

  • Represents Shine and the project at state and local meetings.

  • Monitor progress towards deliverables including parent and provider awareness, parent and provider participation, and advocacy.

  • Provides thought leadership in statewide planning and the evolution of North Carolina’s Family Child Care Network supports and infrastructure.

  • Develop and submit reports, data dashboards, and presentations to funders and leadership.

  • Support integration of communities of practice, self-directed learning, and one-on-one coaching for FCC providers

  • Ensures Shine Coaches, the Family Engagement Specialist, and subcontractor facilitators deliver TA and communities of practice with fidelity to evidence-based models.

  • Oversees the dissemination of family and community engagement resources and materials to licensed FCC providers

  • Tracks and oversees the delivery of face-to-face and virtual parent/guardian education training sessions to increase parent awareness and advocacy

  • Facilitates problem-solving and peer learning across the statewide network.

  • Evaluates the progress and participate in the process of continuous improvement utilizing both data and observations

  • Participates in assigned meetings, events and training as required.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Education, Public Administration, Social Work, or related field; Master’s preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience managing large-scale projects, preferably in early childhood or public systems.

  • Experience supervising staff and managing subcontractor relationships. Physical exam and background checks are required for this position.

  • Travel required locally or long-distance up to 20% of the time for work-related meetings and functions.

  • Ability to travel across North Carolina

  • Must have a valid driver’s license and/or reliable transportation.

When/Where/How Much

When: Fall 2025

Where: North Carolina remote with 20% travel

How Much: This position pays up to $105,000 annually.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

  • A meaningful mission that drives real change in the lives of children and families

  • A collaborative, inclusive team that values your growth and well-being

  • Robust benefits that support your total wellbeing, including:

    • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with multiple plan options to fit your needs

    • Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions up to $400/individuals & $800/family annually

    • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care expenses

    • 401(k) Retirement Plan with up to 3% company match

    • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Insurance

    • Up to $500 per year in Professional Development Reimbursements

    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling and mental wellness support

    • Wellness Programs , including virtual fitness, nutrition, and mindfulness classes

    • Pet Insurance , Legal Assistance , ID Theft Protection , and Employee Discount Perks

If you’re ready to take on a challenge that matters and lead growth in a company where purpose and values drive every decision, apply now to join us as our next Project Director. Together, we’ll help every child reach their fullest potential!

title: Head of High Touch Customer Success
description:
Overview

Head of High Touch Customer Success

Hi, I'm Casey - Head of Dedicated Customer Success at Ashby; I look after our upmarket customers in the Strategic and High Touch segments. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering 'what is a better way to accomplish this'. That's why I am thrilled to be hiring my backfill: the Head of High Touch Customer Success!

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to elevate the customer experience to the next level. You'll join our Dedicated CSM leadership team, working alongside our Heads of Strategic and EMEA Customer Success, as well as leaders from our Startup CS, Support, Customer Education and Contract Management teams.

About the Role

As Head of High Touch Customer Success, you'll play a critical role in ensuring our customers continue to have an exceptional experience with Ashby as we scale. You'll grow a talented team of CSMs, lead the current Manager of High Touch Customer Success (a recent internal promotion), and drive the overall strategy and execution of our High Touch CS function.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and coach both the current Manager of High Touch CS and your own team of CSMs supporting customers across onboarding, adoption, and long-term partnership
  • Drive process improvements across the customer journey, with a focus on post-onboarding and adoption
  • Help evolve how we deliver consistent, high-quality customer experiences at scale
  • Serve as a key product advocate - partnering closely with internal teams to champion improvements that better support our upper mid-market and lower enterprise customers

Role requirements

  • Team Leadership & Coaching : You have experience leading and developing Customer Success Managers in a B2B SaaS environment. You know how to foster a culture of empathy, accountability, and continuous growth.
  • Customer Journey Expertise : You understand the customer lifecycle and have helped improve onboarding, adoption, and retention through thoughtful, repeatable approaches.
  • Operational Mindset : You've helped implement and improve team processes, and you bring a structured lens to scaling what works while staying adaptable.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration : You're comfortable partnering with teams like Sales, Product, and Support to align around customer needs and elevate the experience.
  • Problem-Solving Orientation : You don't rely on "what worked before" - you're thoughtful, pragmatic, and eager to find solutions that fit the unique needs of your team and customers.
  • Data-Driven : You are comfortable using data and metrics to drive decision-making, continually improving both the team and customer experience.
  • Customer-First Thinking : You have a deep understanding of B2B customer needs and have a history of ensuring outstanding support experiences.
  • Lifecycle Awareness : You're familiar with key stages like onboarding and adoption, and you've supported efforts that drive product engagement and help customers achieve their goals.

You'll Be a Great Fit If You:

  • You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.
  • You are a great listener. You see your role as 1) Advocate for the Customer Success Team as well as 2) Voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our product roadmap continues to evolve.
  • You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.
  • You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.
  • Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You take pride in internal operations.
  • You're an advocate for the team. We'll be looking for your help when it comes to defining resourcing and headcount planning.
  • You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help teams grow.

You Might Not Be a Fit If:

  • You prefer an in-person role over remote.
  • You're not eager to roll up your sleeves and get into the weeds (e.g. call shadowing isn't interesting to you).
  • You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.
  • You thrive in environments where you lead a simple, established product rather than a dynamic, evolving one.
  • You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize)

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.
  • We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.
  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we'll get into these and other values during the hiring process.

The Interview

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

  • 30 min - Recruiter Screen
  • 60 min - Hiring Manager Interview with Global Head of Dedicated CS
  • 60 min - Presentation & Interview with our Manager of High Touch, Head of Startup & Head of Strategic
  • Final Round:
  • 30 min - Interview with VP of Customer Success
  • 30 min - Interview with CEO
  • 10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

  • You'll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.
  • You get to represent a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn't feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby - do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect "Vacation?" in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it
  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval
  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.
LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.
As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.
Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

  • Lead a team of remote engineers

  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

title: Pessoa engenheira de dados senior remoto
description:
Overview

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia, este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco.

Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento com um time incrível, ambiente descontraído e espírito colaborativo. Valorizamos as pessoas e promovemos um ambiente de desenvolvimento, destacando a nossa cultura de Atlantes. Estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking GPTW.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando-se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando-se com os gerentes do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos-chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados baseadas em nuvem, com capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencial) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos (ex.: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, MapReduce).
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data (ex.: HDFS, YARN; ou soluções em nuvem como S3, EMR).
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho (ex.: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Formatos de lakehouse modernos (ex.: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi).
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes (ex.: Trino/Presto).
  • Experiência em aquisição e persistência de novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem (AWS ou GCP) para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.

Idioma

  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.

Desejável

  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e comunicação de rede segura.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real (Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes).
  • Governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, ODI/OWB, SSIS, etc.).
  • Ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Padrões de design de software (MVC, MVVM).
  • Conhecimentos de Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Controle de versão de software (Git).

Diversidade e Inclusão

No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos. Valorizamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, com oportunidades equitativas e respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico-racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo-sexual e de pessoas com deficiência.

Impacto Social

O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão investe em ações de voluntariado com foco em impacto social positivo, apoiando organizações do terceiro setor e projetos que atendem públicos contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos projeto para capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social, com resultados de formação em Lógica de Programação Básica.

Temos como propósito desenvolver espaços onde as pessoas sejam acolhidas com dignidade e se sintam melhores onde moram, trabalham, se hospedam, consomem e investem. #vempraRocontec

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estabelecer com o gestor da área a requisição e recepção de materiais, ferramentas e equipamentos, conferindo pedidos, quantidade, qualidade e preços, armazenando de acordo com exigências e normas para evitar perdas e danos.

Formação acadêmica: Desejável experiência em armazenamento e organização de materiais, familiaridade com normas e procedimentos correlacionados à função. Office básico. Conhecimentos no TRON são um diferencial.

title: Actuarial Director
description:
midsize businesses (SMBs). We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance.

TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that many potential applicants discourage themselves from applying to jobs unless they meet every single requirement. TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium-size customers. So if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

A Brief Overview

The Actuarial Director plays a critical role in supporting and advancing the actuarial function in partnership with the Chief Actuary. This position contributes to the development and execution of pricing strategies, risk management frameworks, and financial planning initiatives. This role is expected and accountable for contributing to efforts to ensure actuarial integrity, profitability, and strategic alignment across the organization’s insurance and professional service fee products.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with the Chief Actuary to develop and implement pricing strategies and frameworks for all insurance and professional service fee products.
  • Lead actuarial analysis and modeling efforts to support financial forecasting, risk assessment, and strategic decision-making.
  • Deliver clear and impactful reports and presentations on actuarial topics to internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership.
  • Support the medical insurance analytics function, including forecasting financial outcomes and providing market and financial plan guidance.
  • Partner with business leaders to develop strategies for specific lines of business, ensuring alignment with actuarial best practices.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to senior leadership on short-, medium-, and long-term goals.
  • Participate in annual and long-term planning processes, contributing actuarial insights to broader business strategies.
  • Maintain and enhance actuarial systems, models, and procedures to ensure accuracy, relevance, and alignment with business needs.
  • Foster a collaborative and development-focused culture within the actuarial team, emphasizing coaching, feedback, and continuous learning.
  • Oversee reserving processes, ensuring data completeness and accuracy in financial reporting systems, and maintaining strong internal controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, Math or related field required

Experience Qualifications

  • Typically, 15+ years of actuarial experience required
  • Experience working in health and welfare consulting with large and small groups preferred
  • Experience working with Health Insurance Carriers preferred

Skills and Abilities

  • Successful candidate will be an effective communicator who can successfully integrate into the Actuarial team and interact with the TriNet senior leadership team with confidence and authority
  • Excellent presentation and facilitation skills
  • A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace
  • Ability to adapt to a fast paced continually changing business and work environment while managing multiple priorities
  • Technical skills to build models, predict outcomes and assess future impacts
  • Strong understanding of business and financial concepts.
  • Must have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Highly effective EQ skills reflecting ownership/accountability, critical thinking, collaboration, demonstrated ability to inspire and empower others, promote inclusivity, transparency and resiliency

Licenses and Certifications

  • ASA Upon Hire required
  • FSA Upon Hire preferred

Travel Requirements

Some travel required

Procuramos gente apaixonada por tecnologia, que quer crescer e se desenvolver num ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Queremos pessoas que:

  • Ambiente Inovador: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time dedicado e dinâmico, que valoriza o seu conhecimento e incentiva o seu crescimento.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo : Oferecemos um espaço onde a aprendizagem e o desenvolvimento são contínuos, proporcionando a você as ferramentas e o suporte necessários para crescer profissionalmente.
  • Impacto Real: Contribua para projetos que realmente fazem a diferença para nossos clientes, utilizando as melhores práticas e soluções tecnológicas.

Se identificou? Então, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Sobre a oportunidade

Responsável por coordenar a operação da infraestrutura de TIC, envolvendo servidores, redes, bancos de dados e segurança. A atuação exige visão estratégica, capacidade de liderança técnica e foco em alta disponibilidade e continuidade dos serviços.

Atividades principais

  • Supervisionar as equipes técnicas de infraestrutura (N3 e NOC);

  • Garantir o cumprimento dos SLAs, segurança da informação e estabilidade da operação;
  • Apoiar técnicos à equipe na solução de incidentes críticos;
  • Elaborar relatórios de operação e apoiar processos de auditoria.

Requisitos obrigatórios

O profissional deverá possuir curso superior completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) , ou curso superior completo em qualquer área , desde que complementado com pós-graduação na área de TI , realizada em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC).

São exigidas as seguintes certificações e formações complementares:

  • Certificação ISO/IEC 27001 ;
  • Certificação ITIL 4 , sendo exigido, no mínimo, o módulo Specialist – Create, Deliver & Support , ou certificação equivalente ou superior da mesma trilha;
  • Certificação HDI – SCTL (Support Center Team Lead) ;
  • Curso de capacitação em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux .

Além da formação e certificações, o profissional deve comprovar:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 (cinco) anos em atividades técnicas relacionadas à área de TI;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 (três) anos em gestão de projetos e liderança de equipes técnicas .

Adicionalmente, é obrigatória a apresentação de ao menos uma das seguintes certificações reconhecidas na área de gerenciamento de projetos e/ou serviços de TI :

  • PMP – Project Management Professional ;
  • CAPM – Certified Associate in Project Management

Só um pouquinho de dados. Ou um montão deles.

Para isso, contamos não só com um time feito de especialistas em business, tecnologia, comunicação e outras áreas, mas com toda a estrutura e apoio do grupo B&Partners , do qual fazemos parte.

Queremos revolucionar o processo de tomada de decisão nas empresas e tornar a ciência de dados mais acessível, para que ela seja uma vantagem competitiva de negócios de diversos segmentos.

Nosso clima é de startup, com desafios, projetos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento constantes. Valorizamos a criatividade, unicidade de bagagem, bem estar e autonomia das pessoas que atuam conosco. Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Assertividade e precisão na entrega.

Overview

The Senior Quality Test Engineer will build test plans, execute tests, reevaluate results, and identify opportunities to automate testing. The role involves researching, designing, documenting, and modifying test specifications to support the development production lifecycle, and providing timely status reports.

Responsibilities

  • Work with Product team to determine requirements and propose approaches to address users' needs.
  • Analyze requirements to determine approach/proposed solution.
  • Design and build test solutions using relevant programming/scripting languages.
  • Thoroughly test solutions using relevant approaches and tools.
  • Conduct research into test-related issues and products.
  • Bring out-of-the-box thinking and solutions to address challenging issues.
  • Effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible and adaptable to learning and understanding new technologies.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed.

Experience and Skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrate integrity and maturity, and a constructive approach to challenges.
  • Experience working as an application designer and software developer for enterprise applications.
  • Hands-on software troubleshooting experience.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience with specific phases of the software development life cycle including requirements gathering, requirements analysis, design, development, and testing.
  • Knowledge/Experience of database design and file management techniques.
  • Knowledge/Experience of Service Oriented Architectures.
  • Knowledge/Experience of Web based Architectures.
  • Effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Flexible and adaptable to learning and understanding new technologies.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed.
  • Open minded, solution oriented and a very good team player.

Must have skills

  • Proficiency in Java, XML, JS, CSS and HTML.
  • Proficiency in testing APIs/services (REST and SOAP) using SoapUI, Postman or equivalent tools.
  • Direct hands-on experience with Java and Apache Groovy, test automation frameworks, Selenium/Appium/Playwright, RestAssured.
  • Hands on Experience in Rest API and container testing.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Scripting (Unix shell scripts and/or Python).
  • Hands on experience in building tests for complex application problems.

Good to have Skills

  • Experience in testing of Data Pipelines is a plus.

Rate: $25-$30/hour (depends on experience level). This is a contract position with candidates expected to work 40 hours/week. Contract duration is 6 months with possible extensions. This position currently does not offer any benefits.

  • Desenvolver os seus colaboradores, com o apoio do Scrum Master, nas competências e habilidades necessárias para a entrega da estratégia;
  • Impulsionar a adoção de práticas DevOps e as principais ferramentas de continuous integration e continuous deployment;
  • Ser referência em DevOps e qualidade de código;
  • Mentorar e dar suporte à liderança de Plataformas Kubernetes;
  • Garantir a estruturação e coordenação dos ambientes de produção CI/CD para implantação de novas versões;

  • Apoiar na integração de plataformas de produtos e serviços (Backend) e auxiliar na elaboração de arquiteturas para novas soluções;
  • Atuar como um Product Manager nas Squads multidisciplinares, entendendo o roadmap de implantação de software em novas soluções com base nas oportunidades de mercado, mapeamento de custos e valor agregado;
  • Auxiliar na execução de decisão da aplicação.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Software;
  • Definição de Orçamentos Departamentais;
  • Análise de Causa Raiz;
  • Gestão de Pessoas;
  • Gestão de Projetos;

Benefícios:

  • Vale-refeição e/ou alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde com isenção em exames preventivos 1 vez ao ano;
  • Total Pass, pra atividade física e bem-estar;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente;
  • Programa de sócios do Agi, o Tô de Dono/a;
  • Universidade interna, a Uni Agi;
  • Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário;
  • Pesquisa semanal de clima, a Sem Climão;
  • Avaliação de performance;
  • Teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, com o Conexão Saúde;
  • Licença-maternidade de 6 meses e licença-paternidade de 20 dias;
  • Dr. Pet: possibilidade de fazer plano de saúde para o seu pet com até 20% de desconto;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas, Indaiatuba, Hortolândia, Santa Bárbara D'Oeste, Americana, Paulínia e Valinhos, sujeito à disponibilidade de assentos e rota.

Conheça nossa cultura

O Agibank é para quem vive em eterna busca de conhecimento e não para mesmo quando tudo e todos jogam contra.

Quem faz parte, sabe que, ao superar desafios, coisas boas acontecem para o cliente, para a empresa e para sua própria carreira. Aqui, a gente se orgulha de reunir uma galera assim: agilizada, gente aberta, corajosa e que busca crescimento.

Prepare-se para sair totalmente da zona de conforto , para escutar feedbacks empáticos, mas radicalmente francos, e para transformar todos os desafios em oportunidade de aprendizado.

No Agibank, a vontade de crescer corre na veia, e quando essa vontade se junta, ela não pede licença. E o ambiente abre passagem para quem transforma caminho em estrada.

Juntos, lutamos por uma experiência bancária que acolhe e encoraja todos os brasileiros.

description:
Overview

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We’re looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions & Product Architect (Deputy CTO) to join our leadership team and scale alongside our cofounder & CTO. This is a client-facing, high-impact role that blends product strategy, solution architecture, and delivery leadership .

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with clients from day one to understand their business needs and shape solutions.
  • Define high-level product requirements, MVP scopes, and roadmaps.
  • Translate business goals into technical architectures and delivery plans.
  • Lead proposal creation (business framing + product requirements + technical approach).
  • Oversee delivery across multiple teams, ensuring quality and accountability.
  • Be a trusted advisor to clients, while mentoring engineering teams internally.
  • Help codify Oowlish’s playbooks so we can scale beyond any single leader.

Must Have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or product/technical consulting.
  • Strong technical breadth (cloud, APIs, modern architectures).
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams/projects and communicate with C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience defining product requirements and MVPs, not just technical designs.
  • Excellent communication skills (English required; Spanish/Portuguese a plus).
  • Backgrounds that could be a great fit:
  • Experience in consulting / outsourcing firms.
  • CTOs or co-founders of startups, with hands-on experience balancing product, tech, and business.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and excited to grow into a future CTO/Partner role.

Benefits & Perks

  • Home office
  • Flexible Hours
  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company

We’re looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to own the behind-the-scenes magic that keeps our revenue engine humming. This isn’t just about cleaning data or updating reports; it’s a detail-heavy role that directly supports how we grow, retain, and forecast revenue across the business.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Keep our HubSpot and Totango data clean, current, and decision-ready

  • Track and surface real-time sales and success performance and spot issues before they escalate

  • Bring clarity to our pipeline and forecasts through custom reporting and cross-team collaboration

  • Act as the glue between revenue teams: Sales, Success, and Leadership rely on you to spot trends and improve processes

  • Own integrations and deployment of tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier , Gong , and help scale them as we grow

  • Use analytical tools to dig into metrics and surface insights that drive action

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have done this before: 2-3 years of experience in a similar role in a B2B SaaS company is a must

  • Have a sharp eye for details, catching inconsistencies, double-checking numbers, and ensuring data integrity is second nature

  • Experience with HubSpot or Salesforce , and you know your way around MySQL, Snowflake, Tableau , or similar tools for working with large data sets

  • Have set up or customized tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, ChiliPiper, Calendly or Zapier, and you know how to make them work for the team (not the other way around)

  • Communicate in English without any problems - B2/C1 level is required

  • Have a high level of ownership and proactivity with a business orientation

We would like to offer you:

  • B2B contract (self-employed) or contract of employment (UoP)

  • Remote work model with flexible hours

  • Possibility to work from one of our offices in Szczecin/Warsaw (if you’re based in Poland) or access to coworking spaces

  • 26 days off guaranteed in a year

  • Great development opportunities – company-supported courses and conferences

  • Individual work tools—MacBook Pro, Dell screen, JBL headphones? You can tailor the equipment to your needs!

  • Sport & wellness benefit

  • Free access to one of the most popular e-book/audiobook services

Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability. What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About The Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns
  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands
  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required
  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)
  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)
  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment
  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices
  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats
  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging
  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats
  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices
  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels
  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment
  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios
  • Setting up projects for edit staff
  • Ingesting and logging footage
  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines
  • Editing lower-level projects
  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)
  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects
  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs
  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits
  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)
  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment
  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms
  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable. We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
RD Station - Pessoa Cientista de Dados Sênior - IA Generativa

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Como alcançamos tudo isso?

Através de um time de mais de 12 mil pessoas que, juntas, oferecem soluções, produtos e educam o mercado. Formamos um ecossistema que se estende por todo o país e que ultrapassa fronteiras, integrando e conectando negócios. Sabemos que o crescimento acontece de gente para gente, e é isso que nos move.

Nosso jeito de ser:

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral : Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade : A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Seu desafio no time

Você fará parte da área de Ciência de Dados da RD Station, contribuindo para iniciativas estratégicas que integram análise avançada, modelagem preditiva e inovação tecnológica. Atuará no ciclo completo de projetos de dados — desde a exploração e preprocessamento até a entrega de modelos escaláveis —, com oportunidade de aplicar conhecimentos em IA generativa para resolver problemas complexos em produtos SaaS.

Suas principais entregas

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos preditivos, sistemas de recomendação e análises estatísticas para otimizar produtos e processos;
  • Aplicar técnicas de IA generativa em casos específicos, como personalização de conteúdo ou automação de tarefas, integrando-as a soluções tradicionais de machine learning;
  • Garantir reprodutibilidade e qualidade nas entregas, utilizando boas práticas de versionamento, testes e documentação;
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e produto para estruturar pipelines robustos e alinhar modelos às necessidades do negócio;
  • Traduzir requisitos técnicos em insights acionáveis, mantendo equilíbrio entre inovação e viabilidade operacional.
  • Domínio em análise exploratória, modelagem estatística e construção de modelos de machine learning tradicionais (supervisionado e não supervisionado);
  • Experiência prática com IA generativa, incluindo LLMs e aplicações em cenários reais (ex: fine-tuning, RAG, avaliação de outputs);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn, além de familiaridade com frameworks de IA generativa (ex: LangChain, LlamaIndex);
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (SQL, manipulação de dados estruturados e não estruturados) e deployment de modelos em produção;
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas, com foco em escalabilidade e métricas claras de sucesso.

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Experiência em MLOps (MLflow, Airflow) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure);
  • Vivência em produtos SaaS B2B com alto volume de dados ou complexidade técnica;
  • Habilidade para comunicar resultados técnicos a stakeholders não técnicos;
  • Participação em projetos ponta a ponta, desde a concepção até o monitoramento pós-deploy;
  • Perfil que valorize a ciência por trás dos dados e saiba equilibrar inovação com pragmatismo.
